platform-syscall-absent.description: The v4 module protocol compiles to the public build profile: the core makes no gas-bounded verifier callback at all, because validators and hooks are plain contracts invoked through the module ABI. The suite deploys the nine public artifacts, drives the atomic initial install, the 24 h configuration-intent path and the 13-field user operation on a published neoxp node, and every check passes.

scenarios.name: SRC-01/02 current source core: build profile and custody-witness execution
checks: the source variant deploys freshly compiled bytes, not a pinned artifact
the v4 public profile carries no private gas-bounded syscall
the v4 core makes no gas-bounded verifier callback: modules are contracts
the atomic initial install allocated module 1
the witness validator advanced its own nonce channel
the refused submission consumed no nonce

scenarios.name: SRC-03 current source core: 24 h intent installs a session key
checks: the intent install allocated module 2 after the delayed confirm
the session grant digest is recorded
the core issues a 32-byte operation digest
the session key advanced its own nonce channel
the refused signature consumed no nonce
the out-of-grant target consumed no nonce

scenarios.name: SRC-04 current source core: hook policy via the intent path
checks: the hook instance was allocated module 2
the hook joined the core-owned hook order
the allowlisted operation advanced the nonce
the blocked operation consumed no nonce
the reconfigured hook allowed the operation

scenarios.name: SRC-10 current source recovery: owner-only policy and custody rotation
checks: the account is permanently owner-only
recovery removed every module instance
recovery emptied the hook order
the matured recovery record is consumed
the account proxy address is unchanged by recovery
recovery rotated the custody to the new owner
recovery advanced the authority epoch by exactly one
the owner-only latch survives recovery: it is monotonic and can never be cleared
recovery re-enabled the built-in operation route
the rebuilt custody subject authorized the built-in operation
no refused submission consumed a nonce on the recovered account
